name: ICE Compiler
summary: Compiles a TI-BASIC-like language to machine code, on the calculator.
description:
ICE compiles a language much like TI-BASIC straight to ez80 machine code, so the result runs at assembly speed instead of being interpreted a token at a time. Programs written this way are dramatically faster than the same thing in TI-BASIC, and can use the colour screen properly.

It runs on the calculator itself: start it, pick one of your source programs from the list, and it writes out a compiled program next to it. There is a commands list in the documentation — the language is close to TI-BASIC but not all of it is there.

2048, elsewhere in this store, was written with it.
author: Peter "PT_" Tillema

install.text: Run prgmICE to compile. It lists the ICE source programs on your calculator; pick one with the arrows and press [enter]. On OS 5.2 or earlier you need the Asm( token in front.
